name: Thijs Reuten, Nina Carberry - § 252/6
title: REPORT on the implementation of the EU-UK Trade and Cooperation Agreement
part_text: ‘calls on the UK Government and all the Member States to significantly increase military assistance for Ukraine and to lift all restrictions on such assistance; recommends, in that regard, that actions undertaken in the framework of the SAFE Regulation by both the Member States and the UK also include Ukraine and its defence technology and industrial base;’
